_comment: Committed prior for the newly-invalid-row eval check (1f916 #3539, #034). Each entry is an eval task name accepted as measurement_invalid; a row NOT listed that turns up measurement_invalid fails the eval. Accepting a newly-dead row is a deliberate, reviewable edit here, not a side effect of re-running --baseline. Empty means no row is accepted-dead, so any invalid row is a regression. NOTE (1f916 #4266): the loader checks this file's SHAPE, not whether the listed rows are the ones actually/acceptably dead -- that is a content question with no local oracle. Its evidence is this file's git history (who committed a row, when), an external record; not a self-authored field, which would be a mirror not a witness.
